title: Amsterdam-based Silverflow, a cloud-native card payment processing service with a single API to card networks, raised a $40M Series B led by Picus Capital (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Amsterdam-based Silverflow, a cloud-native card payment processing service with a single API to card networks, raised a $40M Series B led by Picus Capital — Amsterdam-based Silverflow is expanding its cloud-native payment processing platform to support global growth, enhance product capabilities …
